title: Temporal watermark information for early link detection under the frozen 50-node common-G estimator
scope: first paper only; two-dimensional messages, 50-node common-G estimator, original six monitored directed links

legacy_evidence.v3_status: read-only historical exploratory selection and independent test, not a new confirmation

phase0_replay.purpose: independently reconstruct source summary fields from recorded V3 path seeds and compare the paired replay to the archived arrays

method_arms.A: iid watermark with frozen plugin-KL score
method_arms.B: fixed negative watermark with frozen plugin-KL score
method_arms.C: iid watermark with causal matched-key subspace GLRT
method_arms.D: fixed negative watermark with causal matched-key subspace GLRT
method_arms.E_iid: iid watermark with an independent same-law GLRT key schedule
method_arms.E_negative: fixed negative watermark with an independent same-law GLRT key schedule

stage1_attribution_development.common_decision_times: k=5..149; 6,7,8 slots with zero first packet at k=5,6,7; full communicated windows thereafter
stage1_attribution_development.threshold: per-model and score-family path-max calibration; max over all six monitored links and k=5..149; strict score>threshold; finite-sample rank ceil((n+1)*0.95)
stage1_attribution_development.primary_endpoint: For each path and each of the six truly affected links, whether any alarm occurs at onset,onset+1,onset+2. Average six link indicators within path, then equally across paths and the 12 scenarios.
stage1_attribution_development.primary_interaction: (D-C)-(B-A) in paired early per-link detection probability
stage1_attribution_development.paired_unit: whole physical path; keep six links, time, methods, watermark streams, and within-path dependence intact
report: per-link first alarm delay with no-alarm censoring

stage1_independent_confirmation.go_rule: Use the identical model and recalibrate on independent healthy calibration paths per dynamics/family. See PROTOCOL_CORRECTION.md for variance-based sizes and freeze.
stage1_independent_confirmation.confirmation_statistics: scenario-stratified whole-path paired bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed namespace [20261125,8317,2,9001]; one-sided Bonferroni alpha=.05/3 for registered B-A, D-C and interaction contrasts on the primary endpoint; true-key versus wrong-key contrasts are secondary

stage2_radial_bin_design.strong_rule: Use 2t for a direction transition only if both adjacent S values exceed ln(2); otherwise use t.
stage2_radial_bin_design.radial_law: S=||beta||^2 ~ Exp(1), independent across time and source
stage2_radial_bin_design.control: same radial bins, assign strong theta independently with probability 1/4; score the hidden-label mixture using its actual kernel law
stage2_radial_bin_design.budget: mean adjacent mutual information, not conditional worst-case information; verify both conditional values separately
stage2_radial_bin_design.proxy_gate: Always report full-system geometry and test both receivers in development; see PROTOCOL_CORRECTION.md for receiver selection
stage2_radial_bin_design.primary_confirmatory_endpoint_if_reached: radial-bin minus fixed-negative early-three-attacked-report per-path affected-link detection-rate difference; 1 percentage point is the registered practical-value reference
stage2_radial_bin_design.closed_loop_claim: requires separate paired affected-node/network MSE and healthy-risk results; detection improvement alone is not an estimation benefit

seed_separation.old_v3_replay: reconstruct only from its recorded namespaces; never used in new estimates

claim_scope: all new path results are development or independent confirmation for the fixed six-link support; no unknown-support or cryptographic-secrecy claim; GLRT is a known-model comparator rather than a claimed novel detector
